args.subject: PHL label confusion: Covey & Lark / Pellow Home Living
args.body:
Hi June,

A quick note on a label mismatch for Pellow Home Living (PHL):

- Pellow Home Living was renamed from Covey & Lark on 16 Feb.
- A saved report still reads "Covey — Late Arrivals", using the old name.
- The old label may cause duplicate searches for the account, so the report label should be updated to Pellow Home Living.

Could you check whether the report label can be corrected on your side? Thanks.

Sofia
